period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2019. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2020 (for Q1, cumulative = discrete). SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; extracted via OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3), good quality with only minor artifacts. Extensively cross-validated: the 31-Dec-2019 comparative column (total assets 11,240.14m, total liabilities 22,614.51m, equity -11,374.37m, deposits 11,960.39m, investments 8,458.07m, NAVPS -17.11, retained earnings -18,654,158,394) matches this dataset's own 2020_Q3.json Dec-2019 comparative exactly on every field; the Mar-2019 comparative P&L column (investment income 84,899,217; net investment income -33,607,810; total operating income -14,021,401; operating profit before provision -127,179,861; provision -23,000,000; PBT -104,179,861; tax 626,914; PAT -104,806,775; NOCFPS 0.19) matches 2019_Q1.json's own figures exactly. The source's own explanatory note independently states 'Net Operating Cash Flow per share- NOCFPS were (0.15) on 31 March 2020 but it were 0.19 on 31 March 2019', confirming both this quarter's NOCFPS and the 2019_Q1.json comparative. Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C with B derived as A-C since a sub-line total was not independently legible; C-D=PBT with D=0 this quarter; PBT-tax=PAT; PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.09).
